The average number of steps for completed runs created before October 28 2026 (and that have at least one step) is **2.89** steps.

```json
{
  "question": "On average, how many steps did completed runs created before October 28, 2026 have? Only count runs that have at least one step.",
  "sql": "SELECT AVG(step_count)::numeric(10,2) AS avg_steps\nFROM (\n  SELECT r.id, COUNT(s.id) AS step_count\n  FROM runs r\n  JOIN steps s ON s.run_id = r.id\n  WHERE r.status = 'completed'\n    AND r.created_at < '2026-10-28'\n  GROUP BY r.id\n) sub;",
  "row_count": 1,
  "answer": "2.89"
}
```
